abstract.t: This document specifies two things two independent implementations would have to agree on. The first is the spelling of a Decentralized Identifier that names a ~handle together with the DNS zone that publishes the handle's signed envelope. The second is the DID document a resolver derives from that envelope, once the envelope has passed DNSSEC validation and signature verification under the companion specification for discovering Model Context Protocol servers through DNS TXT records. The method defines no record, cryptographic primitive or registry of its own. Resolution requires DNSSEC. The method is usable only for signed zones. The envelope record carries no key history, and revocation cannot presently be observed from DNS alone, and the document says what a resolver can and cannot conclude as a result. No deployment exists. The document is Informational and is offered for review as an Independent Submission.
